summary: Comprehensive testing of new team management features completed. Fixed critical backend bug in /api/teams/lookup route ordering. All 24 backend tests passing (100%). All frontend UI components verified working.

fixed_bugs.issue: Route was defined after /api/teams/{team_id}, causing FastAPI to match 'lookup' as a team_id (404 error)
fixed_bugs.fix: Moved /api/teams/lookup route definition BEFORE /api/teams/{team_id} in server.py

critical_code_review_comments: All new features follow existing code patterns and are well implemented
Norwegian language (nb-NO) used consistently in UI text (Gutter/Jenter/Mixed, Vennskapskamper, Meldinger, etc.)
Team code generation uses 6-character alphanumeric codes with uniqueness validation
Network system prevents adding own teams and duplicates (proper 400/409 responses)
Friendly invite system creates messages for both sender and receiver
seed_data_creation: Created test teams and invites during pytest execution (cleaned up via TestCleanup class)
context_for_next_testing_agent: All new features (gender selection, manager registration, team codes, network system, friendly invites, messages) are fully functional. Backend route ordering bug was fixed. Demo user has 4 existing teams (Blitz Futsal, Storm G14, Orn FK, Test England Team).

backend_api.GET /api/teams returns all fields: PASS - team_code, gender, manager_name, manager_phone included

backend_api.POST /api/network/add: PASS - Adds team by code, prevents own team and duplicates

rca_of_bug_fixed.issue: GET /api/teams/lookup endpoint returning 404 for valid team codes
rca_of_bug_fixed.root_cause: In FastAPI, route registration order matters. The /api/teams/lookup route was defined at line 419 AFTER /api/teams/{team_id} at line 241. FastAPI matched '/api/teams/lookup' as a team_id parameter, calling get_team() which returned 404.
rca_of_bug_fixed.fix_applied: Moved the lookup endpoint definition to appear BEFORE the {team_id} parameterized route (now at line 241-253 after GET /api/teams)
rca_of_bug_fixed.verification: Tested with curl - lookup now correctly returns team public info
